name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.7-dev.18 (dev build with the final models and music, Osama 25 Nov 2026): 0.9.7-dev.17 gameplay plus every queued change since, and a new Models & music package from the full model stage (Lynx family and icons, SR-5 and PCL-181 fixes, airborne and Medium CAB bodies, NVG/goggles, tripod crews, weapon model rules; 6 European preview models held back). Later builds can be gameplay-only. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.101.
